text:
morgan: quick heads-up — I have a small style-sweep PR that fixes a handful of naming/format nits (link: https://repo.redwood.dev/p/1234). want to land before tomorrow's merge window, so pinging for 1-2 quick approvals.

sam: can you paste the main diff or a short summary? quick eyeball.

morgan: sure — mostly: consistent camelCase for exported IDs (requestID instead of requestid), a couple of proto json_name fixes, and running gofumpt across the package. example snippet:```diff
- func handleRequest(ctx context.Context, requestid string) error {
+ func handleRequest(ctx context.Context, requestID string) error {
``` small and mechanical. no behavior changes.

ci-bot: CI: pre-merge checks queued. linters and unit tests will run.

leo: skimmed the diff — looks safe. one nit: exported fn doc missing on pkg/service/handler.go line 42. can you add a one-liner?

morgan: yep; will add `// HandleRequest processes incoming requests and routes to handlers.` and push.

vincent: also saw a proto json_name mismatch in user.proto — changed to `userId` in the PR which should match frontend; good catch. :thumbsup:

maya: if CI passes after the docstring I'll approve. not blocking.

morgan: pushed docstring and re-ran `gofumpt -w`. pushed force-update. CI retriggered.

ci-bot: CI: running — unit tests (✓), linters (✓), integration (✓). all checks passed.

sam: LGTM. approving now.

leo: approved.

maya: approved :shipit:

morgan: thanks all — landing in the next 5m during the merge window. if anyone sees regressions ping me and I'll revert.

ci-bot: Merge: PR #1234 merged by morgan at 2024-03-29T16:20:50Z. deploy pipeline triggered.
